title: Parameter- and Bandwidth-Efficient Edge--cloud Many-to-Many Speech-to-Text Translation
abstract: arXiv:2605.28642v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential for speech-to-text translation (S2TT). However, existing deployment paradigms face critical challenges: pure on-device models suffer from resource constraints, while centralized cloud systems incur bandwidth bottlenecks and privacy risks by transmitting raw voice data. In this paper, we propose Edge--cloud Speech Recognition and Translation (ESRT), a parameter-efficient, bandwidth-efficient, and privacy-aware collaborative Edge--cloud MLLM framework. First, we introduce a multi-task weighted curriculum learning strategy to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, improve multilingual balance, and train parameter-efficient ESRT-1B, ESRT-4B, and ESRT-12B models. Second, we enable bandwidth-efficient Edge--cloud inference by retaining a lightweight speech encoder and adapter on the device and transmitting only a compressed tensor to the cloud. Extensive experiment

translated_title: 参数与带宽高效的边缘-云端多对多语音到文本翻译
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在语音到文本翻译（S2TT）方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有的部署范式面临关键挑战：纯端侧模型受资源限制，而集中式云系统因传输原始语音数据而产生带宽瓶颈和隐私风险。在本文中，我们提出边缘-云端语音识别与翻译（ESRT），这是一种参数高效、带宽高效且隐私感知的协作式边缘-云MLLM框架。首先，我们引入多任务加权课程学习策略，以缓解灾难性遗忘、改善多语言平衡，并训练参数高效的ESRT-1B、ESRT-4B和ESRT-12B模型。其次，我们通过在设备上保留轻量级语音编码器和适配器，仅向云端传输压缩张量，实现带宽高效的边缘-云推理。大量实验表明……
tldr: 提出了一种参数和带宽高效的边缘-云协作MLLM框架ESRT，通过多任务加权课程学习训练多尺寸模型，并仅传输压缩张量实现高效推理，兼顾性能与隐私。
en_tdlr: Proposes ESRT, a parameter- and bandwidth-efficient edge-cloud collaborative MLLM framework that trains multi-size models via multi-task weighted curriculum learning and transmits only compressed tensors for efficient inference, balancing performance and privacy.
